name: Uni Abex Alloy Products Limited
about: Uni Abex Alloy Products Limited manufacturers and exports centrifugal and static castings in heat, corrosion, and wear resistant stainless-steel alloys in India, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers heat resistant products, such as reformer tubes/catalyst tubes, hot collectors/headers, bends and elbows, tube support and hangers, radiant coil assembly, ladder side member, reducer and grids, cold cast beam, air injection tube, radiation protection tube, clamping flange, feed tubes, swirlers, coal throw pipe, reformer tubes for gas based DRI, furnace rollers, rot rolls, normalizing furnace rolls, radiant tubes, entry/exit seal rolls, water cooled hearth rolls, soaking rolls, hot bridle rolls, DFH roller assembly, radiant tubes, ring segments, retort, charging/discharging roller for reheating furnace, radiant coils, base trays/fixtures, hearth roll, sealing plates, impeller fans, heating elements for annealing furnace of decarb line, and diffuser segments for bell/batch annealing furnace. It also provides corrosion-resistant products, including deflector rolls, corrosion-resistant, stabilizer rolls, decanter bowls, hot bridle rolls, scroll pipes, end hubs, sink rolls, bowl cylinder, bowl cones, fully machined parts; wear-resistant products, such as feed tubes, wear bars, and skid buttons. The company serves metallurgy, aerospace, environmental solutions, oil and gas, engineering, and agriculture. Uni Abex Alloy Products Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Dharwar, India.
